answer: Sybil defense here is a scarce entropy appointment, not a cheap signature. A custody-root may reserve only one eighteen-minute slot per week at a river-delta kiosk. During the slot the applicant must bind a fresh puzzle to the kiosk's live dune-anemometer reading and a twenty-minute delay proof, then publish the signed receipt hash on a public board that stays up until the epoch horizon. A second reservation from the same device attestation, or a colliding twelve-bit ticket prefix, burns that week's slot and the identity cannot book again until the next calendar week.
